info.name: Get delivery attempts for a specific organization

params.name: organizationId
params.description: Organization ID to filter delivery attempts

params.name: viewType
params.description:
Determines how the organization is interpreted and which costs are returned.
- shipper: the organization is the shipper being billed; costs are filtered to shipper costs and shipper location RBAC applies.
- lsp: the organization is the logistics provider being paid; costs are filtered to LSP costs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of items to skip before returning the results

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return

params.name: sortby
params.description:
Field to sort by (case-insensitive).

Allowed values:
- DeliveryDate (terminal state date; maps to endStateAt)
- OrderId
- DeliveryId
- AttemptId
- RouteId
- ShipperOrganizationName
- AssignedDriverName
- DeliveryState
- UpdatedAt

params.name: search
params.description: Search term to filter delivery attempts by delivery attempt ID or order ID (substring match on both fields)

params.name: deliveryAttemptIds
params.description:
Specific delivery attempt IDs to retrieve (exact match, takes precedence over search).
Supplied as repeated query keys, e.g. `?deliveryAttemptIds=<id1>&deliveryAttemptIds=<id2>`.

items.docs:
Returns delivery attempts for a specific organization, scoped by the viewType parameter:
shipper billing (the organization is the shipper) or LSP payment (the organization is the
logistics provider). Costs are filtered to the requested view type.

As of ITO_DEV-785 eligibility filters (billing period, shipperBillable/lpPayable flags,
required FAP fields) no longer apply so the FAP UI can search any attempts the user wants to
attach. The FAP API batch-attach owns final eligibility decisions.
